title: 3912. Valid Elements in an Array

examples.explanation: nums[0] and nums[5] are always valid. nums[1] and nums[2] are strictly greater than every element to their left. nums[4] is strictly greater than every element to its right. Thus, the answer is [1, 2, 4, 3, 2].
The first and last elements are always valid. No other elements are strictly greater than all elements to their left or to their right. Thus, the answer is [5, 5].
Since there is only one element, it is always valid. Thus, the answer is [1].
